purpose: Geometry-only feasibility of a common compact local cover for the submitted circle/tunnel and the square/slender development cavities.
target_size: clip(min(half void-normal chord, half solid-normal clearance, half smooth curvature radius, L/8), L/64, L/8); at polygon turns >=30 degrees add a corner sample with target L/64
refinement_band: refine a cell if any boundary/corner target lies within distance 2*cell_width from its centre and its target is smaller than cell_width
connectivity: Each active support must have exactly one sampled solid component on 65x65 and 97x97 interior support grids; failure is reported, not repaired by per-case settings.
window: product over coordinates of positive_part(1-z^2)^3; normalized across active local patches; no constant global window may conceal a local coverage hole
independent_checks: normal ray segments stay in the intended solid or void
coverage on independent interior, denser boundary, vertex and near-wall probes
one connected solid component per patch on two grids
outputs: all four geometries and every failure are frozen before any training decision
stop_rule: Do not launch scientific training on this cover unless every registered geometry check passes. A failed geometric criterion requires an explicit common-rule revision and a new protocol, never case-specific repair.
